title: Chinese Mathematical Classics: Original LaTeX and Multilingual Translation Drafts
description:
Public corpus page for Chinese mathematical classics in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record exposes reader PDFs directly and keeps source material in a filtered ZIP artifact.

Status at a glance. [########--] 27 reader/index PDFs present; [######----] working drafts for checking and continuation; [----------] not a proofed critical edition.

Provenance. This page is derived from the current consolidated non-European mathematics release. The source ZIP contains filtered TeX/source artifacts for this corpus; the complete as-received raw provenance archive is preserved on the consolidated record. The workflow collects source scans and witnesses, converts them into TeX drafts, checks them into readable PDFs, and publishes source artifacts for inspection and correction.
notes: Corpus-level public page with reader PDFs first and filtered TeX/source artifacts later.
